verified_facts.text: Jack's Camp is in Botswana's Makgadikgadi Salt Pans, the remnants of an enormous super-lake that once covered most of Southern Africa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jack’s Camp is located in Botswana’s Makgadikgadi Salt Pans, the remnants of an enormous super-lake that used to cover most of Southern Africa.

verified_facts.text: Jack's Camp is one of three camps in a one million-acre private wildlife reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jack’s Camp is one of just three camps in a one million-acre private wildlife reserve.

verified_facts.text: Each guest tent has an expansive deck with a private plunge pool and views of the Makgadikgadi Salt Pans.
verified_facts.excerpt: on the outside there is an expansive deck with private plunge pool and magnificent views of the shimmering Makgadikgadi Salt Pans

verified_facts.text: Tent interiors feature rich textiles from around the world, cabinets of curiosities, Persian rugs and hand-carved beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Their iconic interiors are embellished with rich textiles from around the world, cabinets of curiosities, Persian rugs, hand-carved beds

verified_facts.text: Tents have Natural History Museum cabinets curated by Ralph Bousfield, an over-bed cooling system and an en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ll discover Natural History Museum cabinets curated by Ralph Bousfield himself, an over-bed cooling system to ward off the desert heat and an en-suite bathroom with indoor and outdoor showers.

verified_facts.text: The camp's large mess tent houses a Natural History Museum, a library and an antique pool table.
verified_facts.excerpt: The camp’s large mess tent houses the renowned Natural History Museum, library, vintage 36-seater dining table that served as an officer’s mess table in the 1820s, a well-stocked drinks cabinet and an antique pool table.

verified_facts.text: Guests dine communally at a vintage 36-seater table that served as an officer's mess table in the 1820s.
verified_facts.excerpt: vintage 36-seater dining table that served as an officer’s mess table in the 1820s

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea with cucumber sandwiches and biscuits is served in a round tent strewn with Persian rugs and giant cushions.
verified_facts.excerpt: afternoon tea, where cucumber sandwiches and biscuits are served in a round tent strewn with Persian rugs and giant cushions

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments are available at additional cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa treatments available (at additional cost)

verified_facts.text: The camp has pioneered a meerkat habituation project with researchers, and guests can meet the habituated meerkats.
verified_facts.excerpt: We’ve been busy pioneering a meerkat habituation project with some of the world’s pre-eminent researchers.

verified_facts.text: Activities include Bushman walks, horse riding safaris, helicopter flights over the pans, night drives, game drives and guided quad biking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore this wild, desert landscape the same way the earliest explorers did – on horseback.

verified_facts.text: Guided quad biking crosses the salt-crusted pans.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pure desert adventure. Once a super lake, take an exhilarating quad bike across the salt-crusted pans.

verified_facts.text: A helicopter flight over the Makgadikgadi Pans can be taken with doors on or off.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy a helicopter flight over the Makgadikgadi Pans (doors on or off)

verified_facts.text: From November to March, 30,000 zebra and wildebeest arrive on the pans in Africa's second largest migration.
verified_facts.excerpt: Witness the 2nd largest migration in Africa. Nov-March 30,000 zebra & wildebeest arrive on the Pans.

verified_facts.text: Between March and April the pans are a flamingo breeding site.
verified_facts.excerpt: A flamingo breeding site – between March & April – the Makgadikgadi Pans turns in to a pink extravaganza.

verified_facts.text: Wildlife includes brown hyena, aardwolves, bat-eared foxes, honey badgers and black-maned Kalahari lion.
verified_facts.excerpt: Other carnivores that know how to eke out their survival here include aardwolves and bat-eared foxes, honey badgers and black-maned Kalahari lion.

verified_facts.text: Adventurer Jack Bousfield set up the first camp on the site in the 1960s.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the 1960s, crocodile catcher and legendary adventurer Jack Bousfield set out on a trapping expedition in the desolate Makgadikgadi Pans.

verified_facts.text: After Jack's death in 1992, his son Ralph refurbished Jack's Camp in a nostalgic 1940s style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jack’s Camp was refurbished in the nostalgic 1940s style we know today

verified_facts.text: The decor mixes Persian rugs, brass fittings, luxuriant textiles and mahogany vintage travel furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: this is a stylish fusion of Persian rugs, brass fittings, luxuriant textiles and mahogany vintage travel furniture

verified_facts.text: Framed Peter Beard pictures hang alongside original posters from French taxidermist Deyrolle and Bousfield family photos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Framed Peter Beard pictures sit alongside original posters from French taxidermist Deyrolle, both complemented by Bousfield family photos.

verified_facts.text: Kids of all ages are allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unlike many safari properties, kids of all ages are allowed.

verified_facts.text: The camp is run on solar power.
verified_facts.excerpt: The camp is entirely run on solar power with a back-up generator.

verified_facts.text: A 24/7 livestream camera is set at the waterhole just in front of camp.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated at the waterhole just in front of camp, our high-definition, 24/7 live stream camera captures all of the action

verified_facts.text: Jack's Camp is open year round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jack’s Camp is a year-round destination, yet the two seasons couldn’t be more different.

verified_facts.text: Guests help themselves to drinks at an honesty bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’re invited to help yourself to a drink at the honesty bar
